mitigations.threat_name: LLM Prompt Injection via Malicious Response Content
mitigations.title: LLM Response Schema Validation
mitigations.description: Enforce JSON schema validation on all LLM outputs using the canonical graph schema. Reject and re-prompt on schema violations rather than propagating malformed data to downstream agents.

mitigations.threat_name: LLM Prompt Injection via Malicious Response Content
mitigations.title: HITL Review of LLM Outputs at Validation Gates
mitigations.description: Require human analyst review at HITL checkpoints after trust boundary analysis and threat generation stages before pipeline execution continues.

mitigations.threat_name: Supply Chain Compromise via PyPI Dependency Substitution
mitigations.title: Dependency Hash Pinning
mitigations.description: Pin all direct and transitive dependencies with SHA-256 hashes in requirements.txt using pip-compile --generate-hashes. pip rejects packages whose hash does not match.

mitigations.threat_name: Supply Chain Compromise via PyPI Dependency Substitution
mitigations.title: Periodic Dependency Audit
mitigations.description: Run pip-audit and enable Dependabot alerts on a regular schedule to detect known CVEs in pinned dependencies. Update versions within 30 days of a disclosed vulnerability.

mitigations.threat_name: Insider Threat: Malicious Code Injection via Contributor Access
mitigations.title: Branch Protection and Required PR Reviews
mitigations.description: Enforce protected main branch with a minimum of one required reviewer approval, mandatory status checks, no force pushes, and GPG-signed commits for all merges.

mitigations.threat_name: Insider Threat: Malicious Code Injection via Contributor Access
mitigations.title: Contributor Vetting and Code Review Policy
mitigations.description: All contributions require review by a project maintainer. External contributors must have at least two prior approved contributions before receiving write access. Access is reviewed and revoked when no longer needed.
